title: Variant Agentic Ladder model
description: The model behind the Variant Agentic Ladder: three levels, three scopes per level, disciplines, steps, tests and topics. Learning resources live in resources/<topic id>.json, described by $defs.resourceFile. For reading rather than parsing, ladder.md and ladder/<discipline>.md hold the same content as Markdown.

LEVELS.description: The three levels, in order. A person works on the first level whose test they do not pass yet.

lvl.description: Longer label shown on the page.

idea.description: What the level is about, in one sentence.

SCOPES.description: Who the work is for. Every level has topics in every scope.

k.description: "self" is yourself, "team" is initiative so the team uses AI well and keeps quality, "org" is what you advise the client. Organization means the client, not Variant.

lede.description: One sentence on what the scope covers.

DISC.description: Disciplines. "general" shows only the topics every discipline shares.

k.description: Discipline key, used in PATH, TOPICS[].disc and ratings.

STEPS.description: One step per level for the team and the client, shared by all disciplines. Index i is level i + 1.

PATH.description: Per discipline key: the step for yourself and the "You are there when" test at each level. Index i is level i + 1.

tests.description: You pass level i + 1 when tests[i] is true for you.

TOPICS.description: What to train on. A flat list; order does not matter.

id.description: Stable slug. Viewers' ratings are saved under it, so it never changes and is never reused. Resources are in resources/<id>.json.

disc.description: Discipline keys that see this topic, or ["all"] for every discipline.

core.description: Core topics show first. The rest fold under "more at this level".

ask.description: A question to ask yourself to see if you do it.

src.description: Interview numbers behind the topic, kept for review. S is the self-submitted map. Not shown on the page and not a count to report.

resourceFile.description: resources/<topic id>.json: the learning resources for one topic. Shared by every discipline the topic covers.

about.description: Names the topic and links the contribution rules.

lang.description: Two-letter language code. English when left out.

disc.description: Limits the resource to one of the topic's disciplines.
